test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Refrigeration & Air Conditioning Mechanic) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question:
Which of the following statements about title block is/are true?

Statement 1: The title block is situated in the bottom right-hand corner of the drawing sheet.

Statement 2: The contents of the title block are standardised and cannot be modified to suit individual company needs.

options.text: Statement 1 is true, but statement 2 is false
Statement 1 is false, but statement 2 is true

solution:
The correct answer is __Statement 1 is true, but statement 2 is false__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Statement 1__: The title block is indeed situated in the bottom right-hand corner of the drawing sheet, which is a standard practice in engineering and technical drawings.
 
• __Statement 2__: The contents of the title block are not entirely standardised. They can be customised to include company-specific information such as project name, drawing number, or designer details, depending on the company's requirements.
 
• Hence, Statement 1 is true, and Statement 2 is false.
